facts.value: Canonical definition: `void lbAudioAx_80026F2C(u32 flags)`. Only bits 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, and 0x10 contribute fixed masks; the loop processes desired-bank slots 0 through 54.

evidence.why: Complete gated aging and expiration helper.
Countdown, voice, attenuation and dispatch transitions.

facts.rationale: Makes the timer helper's independent gate explicit without changing the demonstrated voice and dispatch transitions.
facts.value: When the update gate is clear, both enable countdowns decrease and clamp to zero, disabling their sides at expiration. Regardless of that gate, enabled sides validate, replace or update retained voices; disabled sides clear retained handles and assign full requested volume to a retained paired side. Shared attenuation is 1.0 only when both handles are absent and 0.2 otherwise. A dispatch request plays and clears nonempty entries among the first sixteen deferred slots and clears the request. Without a dispatch request, those slots age and expire only when the update gate is clear; a set gate preserves their timers and IDs.

facts.value: Supplies the physical Synth-voice usage sample used by Melee's developer sound-status updater to maintain the PVoice recent peak. In the current consumer source, the live sample variable is overwritten with the logical-voice count before printing, so the PVoice row displays that logical count alongside the physical-count peak rather than a correct live physical-count/peak pair.
